correctness.rationale: Complete 13-point finite geometry, 52 forbidden triples, exact face vector 13,78,234,234 and exhaustive 559-face enumeration. A 242-pair discrete-Morse matching is acyclic by an exhaustive 559-vertex topological sort of all 1794 incidences. Critical CW cells: one 0-cell, four 2-cells, seventy 3-cells. The exact signed 4x70 Morse boundary has a unit pivot; its residual is three times a 3x69 matrix with a unimodular 3x3 minor. Therefore its integral Smith diagonal is (1,3,3,3). Since the 2-skeleton is a simply connected wedge of four S2, degree vectors completely classify the 3-cell attaching maps and diagonalization yields three Moore M(Z/3,2) spaces plus 66 S3 summands. A separate ordinary-simplicial mod2/mod3 boundary calculation agrees. The reproducible standard-library code verifies all finite certificates, with no claim for other planes.

value.rationale: The thirteen-point ternary projective plane is the smallest non-Fano projective-plane order and its no-three-collinear arc complex is a canonical finite-geometric topology object. The three independent order-three torsion summands and full Moore-space homotopy splitting are structural information invisible to the arc count or Euler characteristic. This provides a motivated odd-order counterpart to torsion-free cap-complex calculations for other small finite planes. No family theorem is claimed or needed for the precise natural invariant.
